skills.name: Idempotent payment retries
skills.desc: Charge/refund flows that are safe to retry — dedupe keys + at-most-once effects.
skills.prompt: Every mutating PSP call carries an idempotency key derived from the order id. On retry, look up the prior result before re-issuing. Never double-charge.

skills.name: Double-entry ledger invariants
skills.desc: Assert the ledger stays balanced: every posting has an equal-and-opposite entry.
skills.prompt: For any ledger change, verify debits == credits per transaction and that account balances reconcile. Reject a migration that breaks the invariant.

skills.name: OpenAPI contract-first
skills.desc: Design the API from the OpenAPI spec, then generate types + a mock server.
skills.prompt: Author the OpenAPI 3.1 document first. Generate client/server types from it. The spec is the contract other streams build against in parallel.

skills.name: STRIDE threat modeling
skills.desc: Walk a change through STRIDE and note mitigations before it lands.
skills.prompt: For the touched surface, enumerate Spoofing/Tampering/Repudiation/Information-disclosure/DoS/Elevation risks and the concrete mitigation for each.

skills.name: Architecture decision records
skills.desc: Capture each significant decision as a short ADR (context · decision · consequences).
skills.prompt: When a design choice is made, write docs/adr/NNNN-title.md: the context, the decision, the alternatives weighed, and the consequences.
